title: Live Preview: route trace()/runtime output to the Output panel (currently lost)
description: DONE (agent-1312). BUG: Live Preview's <RufflePlayer> was rendered WITHOUT an onTrace prop, so trace()/runtime diagnostics captured by Ruffle's trace observer had nowhere to go. FIX: LivePreviewPanel now takes an onTrace prop wired in Shell.tsx to the SAME handleTrace Test Movie uses (useExportHandlers -> uiStore.setOutputMessages), so both routes feed one Output store. No-leak/no-dup: RufflePlayer registers one traceObserver per load and restores console on each reload/unmount; panel emits a lazy '─── reload ───' separator on the first trace of each new SWF. VERIFY: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build PASS; authoring-ui 75 files / 979 tests PASS; new e2e apps/desktop/e2e/live-preview-trace.spec.ts (2 tests) PASS; existing live-preview.spec.ts + trace-output.spec.ts (3 tests) PASS. Docs: docs/34-live-preview.md updated.
